external.blind_pipeline: The generator writes the file directly into the staging folder. Accept only its metadata output (path, size, seed, etc.). Do not open the file.
external.tool: any external generator or helper program the user has connected

muse-image.blind_pipeline: Accept only metadata (local path and byte size) from the generation result. Do not open the file.
muse-image.subject_handling: If, and only if, the job carries a user-registered subject_profile, pass its reference image and appearance/context text together with the job's scene text (the generation instruction). Otherwise pass the instruction alone.
muse-image.tool: media.generate_image (in the user's own Muse environment)

muse-video.blind_pipeline: Accept only metadata from the generation result. Do not open the file.
muse-video.tool: media.generate_video (in the user's own Muse environment)

note: Generic backend contract for the Encrypted Generation Pipeline. A backend is anything that writes a generated file into the staging folder; the pipeline then encrypts it without opening it. No backend entry may hardcode a specific person, character, reference image, or appearance text — recurring-subject information belongs to the user's own optional subject_profile (empty by default).
